blocks.html:
Storage rooms for finished products that are flammable or combustible liquids shall be separated from the processing area by fire barriers constructed in accordance with Section 707 or horizontal assemblies constructed in accordance with Section 711, or both having a fire-resistance rating of at least 2 hours, and openings in the walls shall be protected with approved opening protectives.
Section BC 419: Reserved
Section BC 420: Groups I-1, R-1, R-2, R-3
